info.name: CapAuth
info.description:
CapAuth lets you sign in to Nextcloud using your sovereign PGP key. No passwords. No OAuth flows. Just cryptographic proof of identity.
Features: - Passwordless PRIMARY login via PGP challenge-response (no password, no Authentik, no OAuth) — a real Nextcloud user backend, not a 2FA second factor. - "Sign in with CapAuth" button on the login page. - Bearer token authentication for API requests. - Auto-provisioning of users from CapAuth identity claims. - Group synchronisation: CapAuth teams → Nextcloud groups.
info.author: SKWorld
